mapper.select:
SELECT amp.* FROM( select am.ID_ as id,am.KEY_ as `key`,am.NAME_ as name,0 as suspensionState, am.META_INFO_ as description,'保存' as suspensionStateName,am.CREATE_TIME_ as createTime from act_re_model am where am.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ is null union ALL
select ap.ID_ as id,ap.KEY_ as `key`,ap.NAME_ as name,ap.DESCRIPTION_ as description, ap.SUSPENSION_STATE as suspensionState, CASE WHEN ap.SUSPENSION_STATE_=1 THEN '激活' ELSE '挂起' END suspensionStateName,ad.DEPLOY_TIME_ as createTime FROM act_re_procdef ap left JOIN act_re_deployment ad on ad.ID_=ap.DEPLOYMENT_ID_)amp ORDER BY amp.createTime desc
